dogecoin.text: Trump vowed to back crypto but launched $TRUMP & $MELANIA meme coins before even taking office. CZ played dumb while enabling $BROCCOLI, yet only $DOGE survived the mess.
Elon hyped $DOGE as the future, then called it a joke coin with no purpose, undermining crypto’s credibility as a serious currency. His flip-flopping hurt the market’s trust.
